[EN] The Tenebrara overseers to the north are closing in on us. If they get to Elenea...well, I don't have to tell you, do I?
[ES] Los Tenebrara overseers al norte se están acercando a nosotros. Si llegan a Elenea... bueno, no tengo que explicártelo, ¿verdad?

[EN] You've done it! Tribune Tesran will be very pleased.
[ES] ¡Lo has logrado! El tribuno Tesran estará muy complacido.
